answer: Require each new agent to lock a stake that only unlocks after its reputation climbs out of a probation nadir, and slash stakes jointly when graders detect clustered identities sharing timing and wording fingerprints. Like ferrous filings snapping to one magnet, sybils betray a common operator: an attacker running fifty accounts must fund fifty bonds and risks losing all of them at once, turning cheap fakes into an umber-dark financial hole.
